message: On 5 September 2024, a person was found in possession of counterfeit currency notes.
On 10 August 2024, a riot occurred for a landowner's benefit and the agent failed to prevent it.
On 25 June 2024, a bookstore owner sold obscene magazines for the first time.
On 20 June 2024, a person dishonestly took a bicycle from outside a shop without consent.
On 10 July 2024, a person dishonestly took a mobile phone from a parked scooter without consent.
On 15 June 2024, a person deceived another into transferring money by a false bank-officer story.
On 8 July 2024, a person deceived another into delivering property by a false investment story.
On 12 June 2024, during an argument a person slapped another causing bodily pain.
On 3 July 2024, during an argument a person slapped another causing bodily pain.
On 18 June 2024, a person entered a private dwelling at night without permission intending to intimidate the occupant.
On 9 July 2024, a person entered a private dwelling at night without permission intending to intimidate the occupant.
On 22 June 2024, a person published a false written statement intending to harm another's reputation.
On 11 July 2024, a person published a false written statement intending to harm another's reputation.
On 5 June 2024, a person was found in possession of forged currency notes knowing they were forged.
On 14 June 2024, a person destroyed documents to hide evidence of a robbery.
On 16 July 2024, a person destroyed documents to hide evidence of a robbery.
On 2 June 2024, a person threatened another with death over a property dispute.
On 7 July 2024, a person threatened another with death over a property dispute.
On 28 June 2024, a person set fire to a warehouse intending to destroy goods inside.
On 4 July 2024, a person set fire to a warehouse intending to destroy goods inside.
